findings.rule: 276-c9 / D51 (failed import lands on a usable not-a-job-post state)
findings.title: After a failed or non-https link import, Add job shows an enabled Analyze button that does nothing and hides Paste from clipboard and Use a link
findings.trigger: Use a link -> Import job with any link in demo (OfflineJobImporter always fails, R4), an http link, a blank field, or a prod 429: applyDraft sets text = "" and notAJobPost = true, so uiState is HasText("", notAJobPost = true). JobScreen draws 'Job description' + Clear, '0 characters', the amber card and Analyze with enabled = true; onAnalyze returns on empty text, so the tap does nothing and has no 'Not available yet' state. JobPasteActions render only for Empty, so the card asks the user to paste while the Paste button is gone until they tap Clear.
findings.proof: JobScreenTest: setScreen(JobUiState.HasText(text = "", notAJobPost = true)); assert 'Paste from clipboard' exists and 'Analyze job' carries the 'Not available yet' stateDescription. Fails at this head. Fix: show JobPasteActions and disable Analyze while text is blank.
